name: Fresh Chakki Atta
description: 100% whole wheat, naturally stone-ground — rich in fibre and protein, for soft rotis that stay fresh for longer.

name: Maida
description: Finely refined flour milled for a smooth, elastic dough — suited to parathas, naan and everyday baking.

name: Sooji / Rava
description: Evenly milled semolina with a consistent grain size — for a perfect upma, kesari or crisp dosa batter.

name: Tandoori Atta
description: A coarser stone-ground wheat atta suited to tandoori rotis and thicker parathas — the same natural, additive-free milling as our Chakki Atta.

name: Besan
description: Finely milled from cleaned chana dal — for pakoras, dhokla, kadhi and everyday Indian cooking.
